fact_check_log.claim: Intro: Europe at the height of summer, Fiji, Mauritius and NZ in cooler months, Bali outside usual wet season
Intro: Europe 'warm seas'
WMO pages: averaging periods and rain-day definitions vary between countries
Naxos (HNMS) August mean 25.0°C, mean max 27.0°C; period not published
Naxos August rain 1.6 mm over 0.3 days
Cyclades in August 'bright'
Milan 1971 to 2000 (Italian Air Force): Aug min 17.6°C, max 28.5°C, 88.8 mm; city station, not lakeside
Lake Como 'summer storms' (venue question and table)
15 August, the Assumption, public holiday in Italy set by law
15 August 'shapes the whole week'
Naples 1971 to 2000: Aug min 19.1°C, max 30.3°C, 35.5 mm, about 3 rain days; not on the Amalfi Coast
Nice 1971 to 2000 (Météo-France): Aug min 20.0°C, max 27.2°C, 23.9 mm over 2.9 days at 1 mm or more
Nice figures applied to 'the coast'
Summer 2026 hottest in France since 1900; heatwave 28 July to 19 August 2026 (single year, flagged as one summer)
Lisbon 1961 to 1990 (IPMA): Aug min 17.7°C, max 27.9°C, 5.7 mm over 2.0 days at 0.1 mm or more
MeteoSwiss: highest temperatures July and August in lower regions; longest, most intense heatwaves above 30°C in June to August
MeteoSwiss: daily averages of 25°C or more possible at lower altitudes in July and August; thunderstorm clouds along the Alpine ridge; more summer than winter precipitation in many places
Switzerland storms 'in the afternoon'
Smartraveller: Indonesia wet season usually around October to April; heavy rain can flood roads in Bali
BMKG Bali: June to August 2026 outlook generally 'Normal and Slightly Dry' (single season, now flagged)
FMS: August a winter month for Fiji and the dry season; August 2026 cool nights, windy periods, trade showers on windward coasts, leeward sides fine and drier (now dated 2026)
Fiji August 2026 extremes 32.7°C Rarawai Mill, 9.8°C Nadarivatu (now marked as one month's readings)
Fiji 'cool nights, trade winds' as typical August (Why August, table, FAQ)
NZ: July usually coldest; most snow in mountains; east and south of South Island may get snow
NZ August 2026 nationwide 9.7°C, 0.7°C above 1991 to 2020 average; dry North Island, very wet west and south of South Island (now flagged as one year)
Smartraveller NZ: ice, snow and fog on roads; mountain and ski-field roads may need chains or 4WD (as at November 2026 added)
NZ 'fires inside' and 'fire-lit lodge'
Port Louis 1971 to 2000 (MMS): Aug min 19.1°C, max 26.8°C, 19.0 mm over 5.0 days at 1 mm or more; January max 31.5°C, 131.0 mm
Mauritius 'conditions differ from coast to coast'
Smartraveller essentials: share itinerary, keep hard copies, subscribe to advice (as at November 2026 added)
Wedded Advisor confirms inclusions in writing before you commit
One Wedded Advisor start to finish, works in your time zone, quotes in AUD, fee agreed in writing before work begins
Legal requirements differ by country (general, links to our legal guides; no country legal claim)
